blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Legal and Ethical Aspects of Computing System) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define Terms of Use and state their main purpose, with one example (2). Explain the importance of Terms of Use: protection of rights, clarity and transparency, and legal safeguards, with an example of each (3 x 2). (8 marks)
(Terms of Use ki definition aur bunyadi maqsad aik misal ke saath likhein (2). Terms of Use ki ahmiyat samjhayein: haqooq ki hifazat, wazahat aur shaffafiyat, aur qanooni hifazat, har aik ki misal ke saath (3 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Terms of Use (Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service) qanooni muahide hain jo batate hain ke service ya product kaise istemal ho. Inhein provider banata hai aur user maanta hai. Maqsad: provider aur user ke darmiyan munsifana aur shaffaf taalluq taa ke dono apne haqooq aur zimmedariyan samjhein. Misal: Gmail par account ke liye Google ki terms maanni hoti hain.

1. Haqooq ki hifazat: privacy, service ka miyar aur shikayat ka haq. Misal: Foodpanda ki terms ghalat order ya der se delivery par kya hoga, batati hain.

2. Wazahat aur shaffafiyat: provider kya dega, kin sharait par, aur kya mana hai; is se ghalat fehmi nahi hoti. Misal: mobile payments ki terms mein limits, fees aur ghair ijazat transaction ki report ka tareeqa.

3. Qanooni hifazat: karobar ko services ke ghalat istemal aur qanooni masail se bachati hain. Misal: online education platform bina ijazat course content share karna mana karta hai.

book_ref.quote: ensuring that both parties understand their rights and obligations

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain the legal ramifications of violating Terms of Use (3), the ethical considerations in Terms of Use (2) and the personal rights of users within Terms of Use (3), with examples. (8 marks)
(Terms of Use todne ke qanooni nataij (3), Terms of Use ke akhlaqi pehlu (2) aur users ke shakhsi haqooq (3) misalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Qanooni nataij: terms todne par jurmana, muqadma ya service se pabandi. Misalein: bina license software par software piracy ki karrawai; PayPak par dhoka dahi ya ghair ijazat transactions par jurmana ya fojdari muqadma.

2. Akhlaqi pehlu: insaaf, shaffafiyat aur user ke haqooq ka ehteraam. Terms saaf aur seedhi hon, dhoke wali ya bohat pechida na hon; ahem maloomat lambe documents mein na chhupai jaye. Misal: online course ki terms certificate, data aur izafi fees wazeh karein; chhupe kharchon ke saath muft na kahein.

3. Shakhsi haqooq: privacy, maloomat aur razamandi wapas lene ka haq. Misal: Personal Data Protection Bill ke tehat user apna data dekh aur durust ya delete karwa sakta hai; e-commerce site par jaan sakta hai ke address aur phone number kaise istemal honge; platform chhorne par account aur data mitwa sakta hai. Terms bar bar badalti hain, is liye waqtan fawaqtan dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Violating the Terms of Use can lead to serious legal consequences

blocks.prompt:
3 What are privacy and security threats? (2) Explain spam, spyware and cookies as security threats, with an example of each (3 x 2). (8 marks)
(Privacy aur security threats kya hain? (2) Spam, spyware aur cookies ko security threats ke taur par aik aik misal ke saath samjhayein (3 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Privacy aur security threats aise khatre hain jo afraad aur idaron ki shakhsi maloomat, maali data aur online security ko nuqsan pohancha sakte hain. Paanch qismein: spam, spyware, cookies, phishing, pharming.

1. Spam: email ya phone par na-pasandeeda messages. Misal: na-maloom numbers se jaali inaam ya saste qarze ki offers; waqt zaya aur dhoke se maloomat ya paise lene ki koshish.

2. Spyware: nuqsan deh software jo chupke se aap ki harkaat dekhta hai. Misal: ghair mo'tabar jagah se free app spyware install kar ke websites aur daali gayi maloomat dekhta hai.

3. Cookies: chhoti files jo websites aap ke device par rakhti hain aur login aur pasand yaad rakhti hain. Misal: shopping site login yaad rakhti hai, magar dekhe gaye products track kar ke ishtihar bhi dikhati hai, yani aap ki browsing dekhi ja rahi hai.

book_ref.quote: There are five primary categories of security threats of using online services

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain phishing and pharming with examples (2 x 2). Compare the five security threats by their method or purpose and their consequences (4). (8 marks)
(Phishing aur pharming ko misalon ke saath samjhayein (2 x 2). Paanch security threats ka un ke tareeqe ya maqsad aur nataij ke lihaz se muwazna karein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Phishing: koi mo'tabar idara ban kar dhoke se shakhsi maloomat lena. Misal: bank jaisi email link par click kar ke account details maangti hai; email jaali hai, paise khatre mein.

2. Pharming: user ko be-khabri mein jaali website par bhej dena. Misal: bank ki site kholte hue jaali hu-ba-hu site khulti hai; login daalne par scammer details le leta hai.

Khususiyat: spam bari tadaad aur ishtiharon se pehchana jata hai, spyware khamoshi se kaam karta hai. Paanchon ka muwazna table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Each type of security threat has a unique method and purpose

rows: Bari tadaad mein na-pasandeeda messages; products bechna ya dhoka
Khamoshi se shakhsi maloomat jama karna
Data chori se privacy ke bare masail
Browsing ki aadaton ka data jama karna
Activity track kar ke privacy mein dakhal
Maali nuqsan aur accounts tak ghair ijazat rasai
Jaali websites par bhej kar maloomat churana
Maali nuqsan aur accounts tak ghair ijazat rasai

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain the following security threat prevention techniques with examples: spam filters, antivirus software, cookie management, and guarding against pharming (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(Security threats se bachao ki yeh techniques misalon ke saath samjhayein: spam filters, antivirus software, cookie management, aur pharming se bachao (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Mukhtalif security tools aur practices shakhsi maloomat ki hifazat karte hain.

1. Spam filters: na-pasandeeda emails inbox se door; khud alag folder mein ya delete.

2. Antivirus software: spyware jaise programs se hifazat; download file check karta hai, nuqsan deh ho to khabardar kar ke rokta hai.

3. Cookie management: faisla ke kaun si cookies rakhni hain aur kaun si mitani hain. Misal: pasandeeda shopping site ki cookies rakhein, baqi mita dein.

4. Pharming se bachao: pharming asli site ke bajaye jaali site par le jati hai. Hamesha address durust aur mehfooz ho, https:// aur padlock ka nishan dekhein.

Kai tareeqe mila kar istemal karna behtar hifazat deta hai.

book_ref.quote: To protect yourself from online threats, it is important to use various security tools and practices

blocks.prompt:
6 Define the digital divide and explain why it is a critical issue (2). Explain the four causes of the digital divide (4 x 1.5). (8 marks)
(Digital divide ki definition likhein aur batayein ke yeh ahem masla kyun hai (2). Digital divide ki chaar wajoohat samjhayein (4 x 1.5).)
blocks.explanation:
Digital divide ICT tak rasai rakhne aur na rakhne wale afraad, aabadiyon aur ilaqon ke darmiyan khala hai (internet, devices, digital literacy). Yeh taleem, rozgar, sehat aur samaji shirkat mein na-barabar mauqe paida karta hai.

Wajoohat:
1. Economic barriers: computer, smartphone ya broadband ka kharcha na utha sakna.
2. Geographical barriers: shehri aur dehi ilaqon mein farq; door ilaqon mein internet ka dhancha kamzor ya na-maujood.
3. Educational barriers: digital literacy ki kami; taleem aur training na hone se technology chalana na aana.
4. Social barriers: umar, jins aur maazoori; buzurg nayi technology kam istemal karte hain, kuch ilaqon mein auraton par saqafati pabandiyan.

book_ref.quote: One of the primary causes of the digital divide is the economic barrier

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain how the digital divide causes educational inequality, economic disparities, health disparities and a digital literacy gap, with an example from Pakistan for each (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke digital divide taleemi na-barabari, maali na-barabari, sehat ki na-barabari aur digital literacy gap kaise paida karta hai, har aik ki Pakistan se misal ke saath (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Digital divide maujooda na-barabari barhata aur nayi paida karta hai.

1. Taleemi na-barabari: COVID-19 mein online taleem ke dauran gharib ya dehi students internet ya device na hone se peeche reh gaye.

2. Maali na-barabari: naukriyon ke liye digital skills chahiye; online job portals aur digital banking zyada tar shehron tak, is liye shehri dehi farq barhta hai.

3. Sehat ki na-barabari: telemedicine aur sehat ki maloomat se mehroom dehi log; tashkhees aur ilaaj mein der.

4. Digital literacy gap: technology se mehroom log digital skills nahi seekhte; naukri ki darkhwast ya sarkari services online nahi le pate.

book_ref.quote: The digital divide has far-reaching impacts on individuals and society as a whole

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the following parts of evaluating information sources, with an example of each: source evaluation, assessing credibility, data provenance and primary sources (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(Information sources ki jaanch ke yeh hisse aik aik misal ke saath samjhayein: source evaluation, assessing credibility, data provenance aur primary sources (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Information sources ki jaanch se pata chalta hai ke maloomat durust aur qabil-e-bharosa hai.

1. Source evaluation: maloomat kahan se aayi. Misal: sarkari websites aur mustanad khabron ke idare.

2. Assessing credibility: maloomat kisi mahir ya ikhtiyar wale se hai? Misal: Eid ka chaand, sarkari Hilal Committee.

3. Data provenance: data ki tareekh, kahan se aaya aur kaise badla. Misal: journal ki study ke tareeqe aur data ke zaraye jaanna.

4. Primary sources: asal ghair tabdeel shuda mawad. Misal: scientists ka research paper primary, kisi aur ka khulasa secondary.

book_ref.quote: This process includes several key steps

blocks.prompt:
9 What are red flags of an unreliable source? Explain with an example (3). What is meant by understanding bias? (3) What are the dangers of relying on unverified sources and how can they be avoided? (2) (8 marks)
(Ghair mo'tabar source ki red flags kya hain? Misal se samjhayein (3). Understanding bias se kya muraad hai? (3) Ghair tasdeeq shuda sources par bharose ke khatre kya hain aur in se kaise bachein? (2))
blocks.explanation:
1. Red flags: nishaniyan ke source shayad ghair mo'tabar hai:
- musannif ki maloomat na hona,
- sansani khez headlines,
- references na dena.
Misal: website jis par musannif ya rabte ki maloomat na ho.

2. Understanding bias: yeh samajhna ke har source ka koi nazariya ya agenda ho sakta hai. Misal: sirf aik rukh batane wali news website. Is liye mukhtalif nazariyat dekhein.

3. Khatre aur ehtiyat: ghair tasdeeq shuda sources se ghalat maloomat phailti aur kamzor faisle hote hain. Asal source, musannif ki qabliyat aur janibdari ki nishaniyan hamesha dekhein.

book_ref.quote: These include lack of author information, sensational headlines, or sources that do not cite their references

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain three positive impacts of computing on individuals and society, with examples from Pakistan or the world (3 + 3 + 2). (8 marks)
(Afraad aur muashre par computing ke teen musbat asraat Pakistan ya duniya ki misalon ke saath samjhayein (3 + 3 + 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Computing ne zindagi, kaam aur rabte ka andaz badal diya hai. Musbat asraat:

1. Maloomat tak rasai: internet par har mauzoo par maloomat; Coursera aur edX se door ilaqon ke students bari universities ke courses lete hain; 'Internet in a Box' door ilaqon mein offline taleemi mawad deta hai.

2. Behtar rabta: Facebook aur X se duniya bhar mein rabta aur #MeToo jaisi tehreekein; Pakistan mein 2014 Peshawar school hamle par aagahi aur yakjehti.

3. Maeeshat ki taraqqi: nayi sanaten aur rozgar; Daraz se chhote karobar mulk bhar aur bahar tak pohanchte hain.

book_ref.quote: One of the most significant positive impacts of computing is the increased accessibility to information

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain three negative impacts of computing on society, with examples from Pakistan (3 + 3 + 2). (8 marks)
(Muashre par computing ke teen manfi asraat Pakistan ki misalon ke saath samjhayein (3 + 3 + 2).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Digital divide: aabadi ka bara hissa jadeed technology se mehroom; Pakistan mein dehi ilaqon mein internet aur devices ki kami se taleem aur rozgar mein na-barabari.

2. Ghalat maloomat aur fake news: samaji bechaini; COVID-19 mein virus aur vaccine ki afwahon se khauf aur uljhan; is liye digital literacy zaroori.

3. Privacy ke khadshat: bohat sa shakhsi data jama hota hai jo qawaneen ke baghair ghalat istemal ho sakta hai; NADRA data leak mazboot data protection ki zaroorat dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the impact of computing is not without its drawbacks

blocks.prompt:
12 Define digital citizenship with an example (2). Explain responsible digital behaviour (2), ethical issues in information use (2) and protecting personal information (2). (8 marks)
(Digital citizenship ki definition misal ke saath likhein (2). Responsible digital behaviour (2), maloomat ke istemal ke akhlaqi masail (2) aur shakhsi maloomat ki hifazat (2) samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Digital citizenship digital technology aur internet ko zimmedari aur akhlaq se istemal karna hai; is se apni aur doosron ki hifazat aur mehfooz digital mahol banta hai. Misal: online forums mein izzat se baat, bullying aur jhooti khabar se parhez, accounts mehfooz rakhna.

1. Responsible digital behaviour:
- Mazboot password: haroof, numbers aur symbols.
- Phishing se bachna: mashkook links par click na karein, bank ki email ki tasdeeq karein.

2. Akhlaqi masail (maloomat ka munsifana aur qanooni istemal):
- Copyright: bina ijazat kisi ka kaam copy na karein.
- Plagiarism se bachna: har khayal ya quote ka asal source likhein.

3. Shakhsi maloomat ki hifazat:
- Privacy settings: Facebook profile private.
- Ghar ka pata ya phone number online na daalein.
Cyber crime NR3C-FIA ko report karein.

book_ref.quote: It encompasses a range of behaviors and practices that help ensure a positive and secure online experience for everyone
